All.text85:
1. Open your wallet and select the asset and click send button.
2. Copy the Greatwall wallet address shown in this transaction.
3. Paste it into the recipient/destination field in wallet for send token.
4. Copy the exact token amount from this transaction and enter it in the amount field.
5. Confirm and send the token to the Greatwall wallet address.
6. Once the transaction is confirmed, your IDR funds will be processed and sent to your bank account.
7. You can monitor your withdrawal progress on this transaction page.
8. Make sure transfer the BTC before the transaction is expired.
9. If you already sent some BTC after expired, just recreate the same transaction with your same wallet address with same amount of BTC withdrawal.

All.text130:
1. Click the Confirm Withdraw button below to automatically open wallet.
2. Wallet will display the exact recipient and amount to send, simply review and confirm.
3. Once confirmed, Greatwall will process your token transaction on-chain.
4. After confirmation, your IDR funds will be automatically sent to your bank account.
5. You can monitor your withdrawal progress live on this page.
6. Ensure to complete the confirmation before the transaction expires.
7. If the transaction expires, you can create a new withdrawal with the same details and try again.
